enchantment.arcane_mag.auto_release.desc: When magazine charge is full and you hit an entity, automatically releases the inscribed spell targeting that entity.
enchantment.arcane_mag.charge_stacks.des: After charge is full, continued hits convert overflow charge into extra cast stacks. Magazine only.
After charge is full, continued hits accumulate overflow. Upon reaching threshold, enters Overdrive: next spell cast gains spell power bonus. Magazine only.
enchantment.arcane_mag.charge_passive.de: Slowly recovers charge over time while holding the gun, no damage required. Magazine only.
enchantment.arcane_mag.ammo_retention.de: Chance to not consume ammo on attack. Higher level = higher retention chance.
enchantment.arcane_mag.arcane_focus.desc: After casting a spell with a gun, the next bullets gain increased headshot multiplier. Higher level = more enhanced bullets.
enchantment.arcane_mag.multi_trigger.des: Each trigger pull fires additional shots. Muzzle only.
enchantment.arcane_mag.mana_magazine.des: When magazine is empty, pay mana to continue shooting without reloading. Magazine only.
enchantment.arcane_mag.kuang_yan.desc: Headshot kills restore a portion of mana.
enchantment.arcane_mag.overflow.desc: When magazine spell charge is full, the gun gains damage and fire rate bonuses for 10 seconds or until the spell is cast.
enchantment.arcane_mag.for_the_people.de: After headshotting 3 different enemies within 6 seconds, gain spell power bonus for 10 seconds (refreshable).
enchantment.arcane_mag.dry_mana_frenzy.d: When mana stays low, gain damage and fire rate bonuses.
enchantment.arcane_mag.shadow_reload.des: Gain True Invisibility when reloading. Magazine only.
enchantment.arcane_mag.mana_hawk_eye.des: While aiming, consumes mana to accumulate shooting damage bonus (capped). Resets when stop aiming. Scope only.
While channeling a continuous spell, the gun gains damage and fire rate bonuses.
enchantment.arcane_mag.spell_resonance.d: Bullets deal additional damage based on enchantment level and magazine spell level. Muzzle only.
enchantment.arcane_mag.fire_frenzy.desc: After 12s of continuous combat, gun damage increases. Removed if no combat action for 3s. Muzzle only.
enchantment.arcane_mag.arcane_frenzy.des: After 12s of continuous combat, spell power increases. Removed if no combat action for 3s. Muzzle only.
enchantment.arcane_mag.pellet_burst.desc: After accumulating enough hits, consumes half of current magazine spell charge to deal area damage around the hit target. Higher level = lower hit threshold. Muzzle only.
enchantment.arcane_mag.brace.desc: After 3s of non-combat, accumulates dual stacks. Gun attacks consume gun stacks for damage bonus, spell casts consume spell stacks for spell power bonus. Switching weapons clears all stacks. Stock only.
enchantment.arcane_mag.unstable_charge.d: Charge gain from hits is randomized. Magazine only.
